The harbor_timesheet_policy_audit task achieved full success by passing the pytest suite, though LiteLLM warnings regarding missing botocore dependencies were noted.
The run achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.77, with the test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite passing in 0.36 seconds. While the execution was successful, LiteLLM issued warnings stating 'No module named botocore', which disabled Bedrock and SageMaker event-stream decoding. Future iterations should ensure environment parity to avoid these warnings, while reusing the logic that satisfied the 1.0 mean reward across trials.
